title: Supervisor(a) de Automação
description:
Job description

Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Nascemos em 2017 com esse compromisso. Desde então, estamos presentes em 39 municípios, com mais de 2,5 mil colaboradores, 6 milhões de clientes e o propósito de atuar da melhor forma para levar saneamento às populações atendidas, ajudando o país a alcançar a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto. O saneamento básico no Brasil está no momento de transformação e marcado por novos projetos de expansão. Para o nosso time, buscamos pessoas protagonistas e dispostas a inovar, atuando como agentes transformadores em prol do nosso objetivo. Alinhado ao nosso DNA, queremos promover um ambiente de trabalho sustentável, desenvolvedor e seguro. Local de Atuação: Cidade, Estado (Nome da Operação)

Main responsibilities
  • Programar e acompanhar serviços de manutenção multidisciplinar e projetos, aplicando conhecimentos específicos em mecânica, eletricidade e automação, assim como, seguir as normas e legislações vigentes, incluindo sustentabilidade;
  • Participar das atividades de apoio técnico à área operacional, suportando a tomada de decisão, conduzindo a equipe e acompanhando projetos, atendendo as necessidades de execução;
  • Efetuar levantamento de custos, elaboração e atualização de orçamentos específicos de materiais, equipamentos e serviços, de acordo com a necessidade;
  • Gerar e controlar os indicadores da área, analisando e acompanhando os resultados obtidos, traçando planos de ação para implantação de melhorias;
  • Revisar e implantar melhorias da política interna de automação;
  • Realizar inspeção na operação com foco nos requisitos legais e técnicos aplicáveis, monitorando e assegurando o cumprimento das normas e ações estabelecidas;
  • Supervisionar a área, assegurando a correta administração de recursos financeiros, administrativos e de pessoal;
  • Supervisão a estações GRPS, via Rádio, além do sistema de comunicação;
  • Promover melhoria contínua dos processos das diversas áreas de eletromecânica/automação;
  • Desenvolver/modificar softwares de CLP´s (ladder), IHM´s e supervisórios implementando melhorias;
  • Especificar hardwares para novas aplicações;
  • Configurar redes de comunicação (TCP/IP, Modbus RTU/TCP);
  • Efetuar análise, diagnóstico de defeitos, manutenção e parametrização de painéis elétricos, motores, inversores, softstarters, instrumentação (pressão, nível e vazão), relés, multimedidores e outros;
  • Realizar a leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos elétricos;

Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Software Engineer I or Senior Software Engineer II , you’ll work to solve problems like:

  • How can we leverage the power of AI to create exceptional, seamless experiences for our customers?
  • How can we design reliable systems for tracking capital movement across a fund’s lifecycle, from initial call to final distribution?

The Team You’ll Work With

Carta’s Fund Operations Engineering Organization is designing the infrastructure that redefines how investment firms across Venture Capital and Private Equity run. We’re building the systems that sit at the heart of fund administration: financial data pipelines, transaction engines, ML-assisted tooling, and full-service automation.

Our teams are multidisciplinary, working closely with product leaders, accountants, data scientists, and ML researchers to take on some of Carta’s most challenging, ambiguous problems. We’re drawn to complexity, motivated by clarity, and operate with a high degree of ownership. If you thrive in early innings problems, enjoy building clean abstractions from messy, real-world scenarios, and want to help shape an industry-standard platform from the ground up, this is the place to do it.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.
  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

O Que Temos Para Você

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Wellhub;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);

Local de Trabalho: Escritórios Corporativos Tijuca e Leblon - RJ

A mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil.

Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de 15.000 lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão.

Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros.

DIVERSIDADE, EQUIDADE E INCLUSÃO

A ALLOS está comprometida com a criação e fomento de um ambiente de trabalho diverso, que acolha pessoas de raças, etnias, gêneros, origens, vivências e perfis variados, priorizando a inclusão social, a redução das desigualdades e práticas empregatícias justas, que promovam a igualdade de oportunidades.

Esperamos que todos os colaboradores, de qualquer cargo ou hierarquia, sintam-se acolhidos e se orientem pelo respeito mútuo.

As nossas vagas são destinadas para pessoas de diferentes grupos, incluindo mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência ou demais grupos sub-representados.

Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities, movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un‑/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health‑and‑safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post‑tournaments
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Internal contacts include investigators, administrators, faculty, staff and students within the department/center and University‑wide. External contacts include government agencies, scientific collaborators, vendors, visitors and the general public.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
  • Familiarity with digital spatial profiling, multiplex imaging or bioinformatics analysis.
  • Experience contributing to NIH‑funded research projects.
  • Prior supervisory or mentoring experience in academic or laboratory settings.
  • Advanced technical expertise in neuroscience and metabolism research.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in data management.
  • Commitment to promoting diversity, equity, inclusion and ethical research practices.

Doctoral degree (Ph.D., M.D., D.V.M. or equivalent) in Neuroscience, Biochemistry, Physiology, Molecular Biology or a related biomedical field. At least 5 years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience in neuroscience, molecular biology or related biomedical research areas. Demonstrated proficiency with rodent models, stereotaxic surgery, microscopy and molecular biology techniques. Strong publication record in high‑impact journals. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary research environment.

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilities Scientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.g., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.g., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About you Experience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred
Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people’s lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

Progress wouldn’t be possible without people; people from different backgrounds, in different locations, performing different roles, but all united by a common goal: the desire to make miracles happen. You can become one of these people. Seek change, embrace new ideas, and explore all the opportunities we have to offer. Pursue progress and discover the extraordinary with us.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is looking for exceptional security‑focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state‑of‑the‑art practices such as threat modeling, table‑top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others.

These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open‑source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open‑source ecosystem.

Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security‑oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long‑term security response for the entire operating system and open‑source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.

Apply here if you are an exceptional security‑focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.

This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self‑discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role.

What you'll do
  • Define, implement, and document new security features
  • Lead security‑focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country‑specific compliance requirements, such as FIPS and Common Criteria (CC) certifications
  • Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
  • Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • A track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
  • Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Results‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
Optional skills we also value
  • Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with the Linux kernel
  • Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
  • Knowledge of low‑level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Performance engineering experience
What we offer you
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference,

title: Gestor(a) Produção Agrícola
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Produção Agrícola para atuar no nosso time de Produção Agrícola.


Quais as responsabilidades?

Comandar a programação diária das atividades para o dia seguinte, alocando as turmas nas atividades de forma a obter o melhor desempenho de cada uma delas, controlar e qualificar a operação de corte manual e colheita mecanizada, sob a ótica da impureza vegetal e mineral;

Estruturar o acompanhamento do desenvolvimento vegetativo e, no caso de alguma ocorrência que venha afetar a cultura, o mesmo reportar à gerência para definir ações de controle e programar diariamente as atividades das locações das turmas para melhor desempenho;

Elaborar preço para o corte de cana, estimando por metro de cana cortada, fazendo a conversão de tonelada para metro, elaborando a coleta diária dos apontamentos de campo, cumprindo os prazos para o fechamento de vencimentos;

Organizar a entrega dos Informes diários de operações, esclarecendo diariamente a locação, quantidade de pessoas e previsão de rendimento operacional;

Supervisionar a aplicação do sistema da qualidade em sua área, implementando em parceria com a Áreade Qualidade, buscando a manutenção das certificações e cumprindo os requisitos, realizando auditorias internas e externas, executando a qualificação de fornecedores e garantindo a qualidade em todas as operações sob sua responsabilidade;

Gerir os recursos humanos da área garantindo que todas as políticas, técnicas e procedimentos sejam cumpridas, manter a equipe motivada por meio de um relacionamento saudável, visando a retenção da MO e gerar expectativa de crescimento na carreira, suprir todas as necessidades sejam técnicas ou operacionais através de treinamentos específicos;

Supervisionar a qualificação e dar condições para que a mão de obra desempenhe as atividades de forma satisfatória no rendimento operacional de plantio e colheita.


Quais os requisitos?

Ensino superior completo em agronomia ou áreas afins;

Sólida vivência em estimativa de produção agrícola, formação de lavoura e variedades de cana;

Experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos;

Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão da rotina, planejamento e orçamento;

Residir na região de Olímpia/SP.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:

About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Engineer to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.

  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.

  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Must have technical and analytical ability to diagnose problems.
  • Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).
  • Solid understanding of web page construction (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Know how to execute standard debugging for website issues.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

Responsável por conceituar a solução que melhor se adequa ao negócio do cliente e que seja possível desenvolver, sem problemas, de acordo com a tecnologia adotada.



Principais atividades

  • Projetar e definir a arquitetura para sistemas complexos novos ou existentes;
  • Consolidar requisitos e especificações de clientes e usuários na definição da arquitetura;
  • Realizar o levantamento de requisitos funcionais e especificações de projetos;
  • Desenvolver as especificações das propostas de soluções arquiteturais;
  • Liderar a evolução de aplicações desde o discovery até a operação contínua em escala;
  • Analisar a solução proposta sob o ponto de vista técnico de forma detalhada;
  • Elaborar a documentação técnica da especificação de requisitos e status report para gestão de projetos;
  • Mitigar impactos em modelos/protótipos e conexões com outros sistemas existentes;
  • Gerenciar o escopo, custos e prazos (cronograma) do projeto;
  • Desenvolver cronogramas e planos de teste para as soluções propostas;
  • Acompanhar testes (System Test, User Acceptance Test e pré-produção);
  • Acompanhar os KPIs referentes à entrega do projeto e posterior operação, propondo ações corretivas e melhorias contínuas.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis para integração de modelos de IA com APIs internas e externas.
  • Atuar na definição de boas práticas de engenharia, segurança e governança de dados em projetos de IA.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, design e dados para transformar problemas de negócio em soluções inteligentes.
  • Avaliar e selecionar frameworks, bibliotecas e serviços de IA que melhor atendam aos objetivos técnicos e estratégicos.

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Arquitetura de Software;
  • Liderança Técnica de aplicações Mobile Nativo e Multiplataforma (Android, iOS e Flutter);
  • Liderança Técnica de microsserviços no paradigma BFF (Java + SpringBoot);
  • Liderança Técnica de aplicações Web (ReactJS, VueJS ou AngularJS);
  • Elaboração de especificação técnica de projetos estruturantes;
  • Gerenciamento de Projetos Ágeis e Cascata;
  • Métricas de Produtos Digitais;
  • Processo / Publicação de Apps em lojas (Google e Apple);
  • Gerenciamento e acompanhamento de produtos Cloud (Azure);
  • Desenvolvimento de soluções com IA (Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, etc.).
  • LLMs (Large Language Models) e integração com plataformas como OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares;
  • MLOps e ferramentas como MLflow, Kubeflow ou Vertex AI;
  • Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.

title: Apparel Designer
description:
Company Description

Founded in Los Angeles in 2023, BioBlanks is an end-to-end sustainable manufacturing platform leveraging innovative practices to create custom apparel for modern businesses and creators. It is no secret that "swag" and "merch" has become synonymous with cheap and undesirable clothing to be worn once and never thought of again. We spent the past 3 years building a proprietary process in downtown Los Angeles to create apparel that rivals your favorite luxury brand while ensuring that the garments are kind to the earth. We use traceable organic materials, low-impact dyes, and regenerative manufacturing methods to ensure our customers not only love our merch, but the earth does as well. And the best part? We handle every step from design, sourcing, production, and delivery to make sure our clients can stay focused on what they do best—building a killer brand.


Job Responsibilities

  • Lead design projects from initial concept through final production-ready files, bringing creative ideas to client briefs while ensuring every detail meets our quality standards.
  • Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to translate their vision into compelling apparel graphics, incorporating feedback throughout the design process.
  • Prepare and finalize all artwork for production, including proper file formats, export settings, and color specifications for print.
  • Maintain organized project documentation in Notion and Google Drive, including technical sheets, status updates, and asset libraries.
  • Contribute to brainstorms and creative sessions with fresh ideas that push beyond conventional approaches to apparel design.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve design workflows, templates, and processes as the company scales.


Hard Skills

  • Proficient in vector and raster-based graphics
  • Experience in traditional illustration (hand-drawing)
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma, including export settings, preparation for print, and required file formats (required)
  • Proficient in web-based tools such as Notion, Google Drive, and Google Sheets
  • 3+ years experience as a graphic designer (required)
  • 2+ years experience as an apparel designer (preferred)
  • Experience working with clients and managing projects (required)
  • Experience with color separation of artwork for printing (preferred)
  • Experience in a startup, agency, or small company environment (preferred)
  • Proficient English fluency (preferred)
  • Intermediate English fluency (required)


Soft Skills

  • Self-starter who takes initiative without needing to be asked
  • Excited to solve problems creatively and think outside the box
  • Strong team player and contributor to company culture
  • Low ego—open to feedback and willing to adapt
  • Not afraid to make mistakes and sees them as opportunities to improve
  • Obsessed with aesthetics and visual design
  • Highly curious with good taste and references within the creative arts
  • Highly productive with strong organizational skills
  • Clear and responsive communicator
  • Passionate about pursuing excellence in all work
  • Thrives on collaboration and constructive feedback
  • Responsible and reliable
  • Wants to grow with a company long-term and build from the ground up


Compensation & Job Information

  • Full-Time (40 hours weekly)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Monthly wellness stipend
  • Paid biweekly · Contractor

title: Solution Architect (Microsoft Power Platform) - Especialista
description:
Responsável por participar da definição da solução que melhor se adeque ao negócio do cliente e que seja possível desenvolver, de acordo com a tecnologia adotada.


Principais atividades

• Administrar recursos técnicos e humanos dos projetos, promovendo alinhamento entre times e entregas dentro do escopo, prazo e qualidade esperada;

• Acompanhar o escopo, custos e prazos (cronograma) do projeto, com uso de metodologias ágeis (exemplos: Scrum e Kanban) e tradicionais (PMBOK);

• Conduzir alinhamentos executivos e influenciar stakeholders de áreas comerciais, produto e tecnologia;

• Atuar na evolução de plataformas de experimentação (offline e online), desde o discovery até a operação contínua em escala;

• Definir diretrizes técnicas e arquiteturais para sistemas complexos, assegurando alinhamento com padrões corporativos e foco em escalabilidade, segurança e interoperabilidade;

• Reunir requisitos e especificações de clientes e usuários na definição da arquitetura, atuando como ponte entre áreas de negócio, produto e tecnologia;

• Realizar o levantamento de requisitos funcionais e especificações de projetos, considerando integração entre sistemas;

• Desenvolver as especificações das propostas de soluções arquiteturais, alinhadas à estratégia de dados, AI e produtos digitais;

• Analisar a solução proposta sob o ponto de vista técnico de forma detalhada, avaliando viabilidade, riscos e impactos em sistemas existentes;

• Elaborar a documentação técnica da especificação de requisitos e status report para gestão de projetos, utilizando ferramentas modernas de documentação e gestão;

• Desenvolver cronogramas e planos de teste para as soluções propostas, incluindo testes de integração, performance e segurança;

• Acompanhar testes (ST, UAT e pré-produção), garantindo qualidade e conformidade técnica;

• Acompanhar a resolução de problemas e bugs, atuando como referência técnica na análise e solução de incidentes;

• Identificar possíveis problemas, impactos em modelos/protótipos e conexões com outros sistemas existentes, promovendo governança técnica e mitigação de riscos;

• Acompanhar os KPIs referentes à entrega do projeto e posterior operação, propondo ações corretivas e melhorias contínuas;

• Avaliar e decidir entre soluções internas (build) ou de mercado (buy), considerando integração com ecossistemas de dados, AI e plataformas digitais;

• Inspirar-se em benchmarks globais para garantir velocidade e qualidade na entrega de soluções, promovendo dezenas de experimentos semanais com rigor metodológico;

• Utilizar soluções de automação e inteligência artificial para acelerar processos de especificação, desenvolvimento e validação técnica.


Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

• Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum e Kanban) e tradicionais (PMBOK);

• Capacidade de administrar times multidisciplinares em torno de uma agenda estratégica de experimentação e inovação;

• Programação em R ou Python para análises, simulações e validações técnicas;

• Modelagem de dados e arquitetura orientada a dados;
